engine.capability: vaani-diarization-heuristic 0.1.0 — spectral-heuristic speaker separation (cepstral + pitch, agglomerative clustering). No trained speaker embedder is installed, so no diarization error rate is claimed.

notes: STRUCTURE AND TIMING ONLY for every real recording. No diarization error rate (DER/JER), purity, recall or any other accuracy figure is reported for real audio, because this repository has no annotated per-speaker reference for it. A number here is an output of the engine or a count derived from one.

Accuracy-shaped figures appear only under cases with kind = "synthetic_reference". Their reference is the per-frame ground truth returned by synth::render, the same call that generated the audio. That measures the engine against a generator with fixed fundamentals, fixed harmonic rolloffs and fixed formants. It is a ceiling for the feature vector, not an estimate of real-world accuracy.

geometry.* is label-free structure in the feature space (pairwise distance distribution, merge-cost sequence, pitch occupancy, per-block shares). It says whether there is any structure to cluster. It is not a correctness measure.
No transcript text, and nothing derived from what was said, is read, derived, printed or written by this harness. Span start and end times are turn timing.

Timing figures are from a release build. The workspace sets opt-level 3, thin LTO and codegen-units 1; a debug build of this engine is roughly fifty times slower and a debug number is not a performance claim.
Cases with source = "external" were produced by vaani-vad's EnergyVad, the engine vaani-app uses. That is another crate's output being measured, not this crate's.
